scope: Bounded static scientific and executable-source review; no model calls, future test truth or forecasts read; only generated mock rows used.
limitations: Test original HR necessarily read during preparation to simulate LR; forecast_freeze flag describes forecast-stage truth access, not whole-process OS read trace.
Zero-shot bicubic proxy and calibrated directional ridge are conventional conditional predictors, not GSURE or unbiased full-HR risk.
12 clusters, 2 candidates and 2 models: each CI is marginal paired percentile interval; no familywise 95% guarantee. Undefined class bootstrap replicates retained as counts.
Scoring guard is phase-boundary only; required external timeout must cap complete process including bootstrap and IO.
Input manifest and actual source/checkpoint bytes should be independently verified after collection; score checks forecasts/predictions but not all truth hashes internally.
Natural target is discrete HR/bicubic, while alias example has known continuous box law. Do not pool these evidence domains.
Classifier observes both point and native outputs; report two-forward cost, not pre-inference prediction or cheap training guidance.
resolved_v1_budget_risk: Vectorized bootstrap matches v1 128 paired mock draws including ties, absent-class draws and both candidates, CI differences <=1e-12. All rows are synthetic audit mocks, not cohort observations.
